verdict: Leads and cost-per-lead held steady despite a planned spend reduction.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 124 leads from Meta at an average cost of $11.84 per lead — and even as weekly spend was pulled back by 22%, cost per lead only edged down 4.45%, meaning the campaigns are running more efficiently, not coasting. The softer lead days from August 14–16 track directly to that lower daily budget, not to ad fatigue. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 63 calls and 100 direction requests this period, and that activity is trending up week over week. We're focused on closing the gap between leads received and appointments booked so that pipeline momentum shows up in the numbers next period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta
average cost per lead this period, down week over week
Google Business Profile calls and direction requests in the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Of the 124 leads received, the pipeline currently shows 75 opportunities and zero booked appointments — the path from lead to appointment is not being fully captured.
watch_item.fix: Appointment tracking is being connected inside the CRM now so next period's report reflects the real conversion rate from lead to chair.
